import type { Strings } from './strings'

// Turkish, with MODZ_LANG=tr. Names take their case with vowel harmony: Pip'i, Mako'yu, Coral'a, Nori'ye.
const VOWELS = 'aeıioöuü'
const HARMONY: Record<string, string> = { a: 'ı', ı: 'ı', e: 'i', i: 'i', o: 'u', u: 'u', ö: 'ü', ü: 'ü' }

const BACK = 'aıou'

const lastVowel = (lower: string): string => [...lower].reverse().find(ch => VOWELS.includes(ch)) ?? 'i'

// A name ending in a vowel takes a buffer y: Mako'yu, Nori'ye.
const suffixed = (name: string, pick: (vowel: string) => string): string => {
  const lower = name.toLocaleLowerCase('tr')
  const buffer = VOWELS.includes(lower.at(-1) ?? '') ? 'y' : ''
  return `${name}'${buffer}${pick(lastVowel(lower))}`
}

const accusative = (name: string): string => suffixed(name, vowel => HARMONY[vowel] ?? 'i')

const dative = (name: string): string => suffixed(name, vowel => (BACK.includes(vowel) ? 'a' : 'e'))

// Every word the panel, the band and the toasts say, in one shape; each language fills it in a
// file of its own (lang-tr.ts, lang-en.ts, lang-ru.ts) and i18n.ts picks one.

export type Lang = 'tr' | 'en' | 'ru'

export type Kinds = Record<'read' | 'edit' | 'run' | 'agent' | 'other', string>

import type { ChatState, CrabMood } from '../types'

/** Other chats on this machine: the card of those waiting on the person and the folded list of the rest. */
export type ChatWords = {
  /** The folded list of the chats that are not waiting. */
  title: string
  /** The card of the chats waiting on the person. */
  waitingTitle: string
  /** "waiting 3 min": how long a chat has waited; `span` is empty under a minute. */
  waiting: (span: string) => string
  /** Working or idle, in the folded list. */
  states: Record<Exclude<ChatState, 'waiting'>, string>
  untitled: string
  more: (n: number) => string
  /** The hub card's addition: "1 chat waits". */
  hubWaits: (n: number) => string
  /** The hub card's addition while none waits: "2 chats working". */
  hubWorks: (n: number) => string
}

/** The home crab: a word for each mood (the drawing's alt and the terminal), and its level pill. */
export type CrabWords = {
  moods: Record<CrabMood, string>
  level: (n: number) => string
}

export type Strings = {
  pane: string
  /** The /agents-info line in the slash command menu. */
  command: string
  cost: string
  tokens: string
  time: string
  collapse: string
  expand: string
  running: string
  finished: string
  planned: string
  empty: string
  emptyTitle: string

  failed: string
  aborted: string
  tokensWord: string
  agentsCount: string

  total: string
